summary: Verified the self-hosted Docker fix for Motor SEO on ARM. Reproduced a clean build on aarch64: fresh python3.11 venv + `pip install -r /app/backend/requirements.prod.txt --extra-index-url https://d33sy5i8bnduwe.cloudfront.net/simple/` resolves and installs successfully (emergentintegrations 0.2.2 pulls litellm 1.80.0 transitively; no ResolutionImpossible). Imports verified: emergentintegrations.llm.chat (LlmChat, UserMessage), openai, google.genai, resend, bs4, markdown, apscheduler, motor, fastapi, cryptography, bcrypt, jwt. Booted uvicorn from the prod venv against a temp Mongo DB with PUBLIC_URL=https://seo.mitiendapro.com; GET /api/ -> {'message':'Motor SEO/AEO activo'}; POST /api/auth/login works and returns token; POST /api/projects creates project with base_url pinned to PUBLIC_URL; GET /api/public/{pid}/connect?key=... returns api_base='https://seo.mitiendapro.com/api/public/{pid}' confirming base_url() honors PUBLIC_URL. Deployment files: Dockerfile.backend references requirements.prod.txt (COPY backend/requirements.prod.txt requirements.txt + pip install with the same extra-index-url); docker-compose.yml parses as valid YAML; install.sh, update.sh, check.sh, backup.sh all pass `bash -n`. Preview UI regression: login admin@motorseo.app/Admin2026! OK; sidebar shows the current OpenFactura project (note: previous Huerta Viva seed from iteration_1 no longer in db); project -> Publicar -> 'Conectar otro proyecto' tab renders the connection link (https://baby-love-growth.preview.emergentagent.com/api/public/863c.../connect?key=ktIz...) and the Prompt pane with full instructions. Cleaned up: killed temp uvicorn (pid 3345), dropped motorseo_prodtest DB, removed /tmp/venv_prod and /tmp/backend_prod.
critical_code_review_comments: requirements.prod.txt is tight and correct (19 packages, matches server.py/content.py/llm.py/routes_*.py imports). litellm comes transitively via emergentintegrations and no longer causes a resolver conflict since it's not pinned directly.

deploy/Dockerfile.backend uses --no-cache-dir and the Emergent extra index; good for ARM reproducibility. Minor: build-essential is kept in the image (increases size ~250MB). Consider a multi-stage build or `apt-get purge build-essential` after pip install for smaller final image. Non-blocking.
install.sh password validation rejects $, quotes, spaces but ADMIN_PASSWORD is still written unquoted into .env.prod via a heredoc — safe only because of that validation. OK.

docker-compose.yml backend has no healthcheck; frontend `depends_on: [backend]` therefore starts as soon as backend container is created, not when it's ready. Minor; nginx (frontend) will serve 502 for the first few seconds after `up -d`. Consider adding `healthcheck` with curl http://localhost:8001/api/ and `depends_on: backend: {condition: service_healthy}`.
backend/core.py reads MONGO_URL/DB_NAME/FERNET_KEY at import time; in production env_file is .env.prod which is fine, but any missing var crashes the module. That is actually desirable (fail-fast).

success_rate.backend: 100% (pip resolution + boot + login + PUBLIC_URL base_url + public/connect all pass)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (preview UI regression: login, project nav, Publicar → Conectar otro proyecto tab show connection link)

seed_data_creation: None in persistent DBs. Temp DB motorseo_prodtest was created with one project and immediately dropped.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Docker is not available in this sandbox; the deploy fix was validated by reproducing a clean venv install against the same extra-index-url and booting uvicorn. If Docker becomes available, run `docker compose build backend && docker compose up -d` and curl http://127.0.0.1:${APP_PORT}/api/ to confirm end-to-end. iteration_1's seeded 'Huerta Viva' project is no longer in the preview DB (now only 'OpenFactura' exists).
